milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-T4 PowerShell script safety and artifact verifier differential tests
milestoneContract.objective: Parse every repository PowerShell script with the Windows PowerShell 5.1 parser and enforce script safety rules, and differentially test the two install-time artifact verifiers (verify-artifact.ps1 and verify-artifact.mjs) against the same tampering cases, recording any asymmetry as a finding without touching protected files or any pending package scope.
requirements: [V6-PKG-T4-POWERSHELL-SAFETY-2026-09-29 founderAuthorization.rule] Founder rule 2026-09-29: A blocked/review-pending package blocks ONLY its own dependency lane; implement the next independent eligible package in an isolated branch, validate, checkpoint, commit, prepare the frozen review bundle, mark it REVIEW_PENDING if Codex is unavailable, and continue; never modify a pending package's branch, bundle, clone, evidence or cycle state.
[V6-PKG-T4-POWERSHELL-SAFETY-2026-09-29 founderAuthorization.constraint] Tests and non-protected documentation only; no protected file, no pending package scope, no merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

Every PowerShell script under scripts/ is parsed with the PowerShell 5.1 parser without errors and without Invoke-Expression; the safety rules reject EncodedCommand, DownloadString/DownloadFile, persistent Set-ExecutionPolicy, piping to Invoke-Expression, entry scripts without $ErrorActionPreference="Stop" and web requests outside the allowlist or without disabled redirects.

Both artifact verifiers accept a clean tree and reject content tamper, a missing file, a manifest without the lockfile and an unsafe path; the Node verifier rejects an unlisted file and the PowerShell verifier behaviour for it is recorded honestly as a known asymmetry and an open finding, not as PASS parity.
install.ps1 runs both verifiers before bootstrap; outside Windows the selftest skips honestly; no protected file changes and no existing test, validator or policy is weakened.
mandatoryFailureCases: a PowerShell parse error or Invoke-Expression use accepted
a tampered artifact tree accepted by either verifier in the shared cases
the unlisted-file asymmetry hidden or reported as parity
a protected file or pending package scope changed
